quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #20
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: A police officer asks you to take a blood alcohol test. You:

options.text: Do not have to take the test if you can prove you were not drinking.
Must take the test or lose your license.
Do not have to take the test if you did not break any traffic laws.
Must take the test or pay a fine.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must take the test or lose your license.
questions.explanation: All drivers agree to a blood alcohol test when asked by police. If you refuse, your license will be suspended for at least one year.

questions.question: Before making a left turn, you should:

options.text: Slow down gradually while checking your rearview mirror.
Watch for oncoming cars and pedestrians.

questions.explanation: Signal 3 to 5 seconds before turning. Check your rearview mirror and slow down gradually. Move into the left lane before the intersection. Wait for traffic and pedestrians to clear, then turn.

questions.question: When making a right turn, your car should be:

options.text: In the center of the street.
On the left side of the street.
On the right side of the street.
Past the center of the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: On the right side of the street.
questions.explanation: Move as far to the right as possible before turning right. Do not cut across other lanes.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead with a road coming from the right.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What helps drivers save gas?

options.text: Letting the car run while sitting in the driveway.

questions.explanation: Hard braking wastes gas because you use fuel to speed back up. Look ahead and slow down gradually or change lanes to avoid sudden stops. This saves gas.

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights is near you, you should:

options.text: Speed up to get out of the way.
Stop immediately and block their path.
Clear a path for the emergency vehicle to pass.
Signal the emergency vehicle when it is safe to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Clear a path for the emergency vehicle to pass.
questions.explanation: Move your vehicle to the side of the road if it is safe to do so. Give the emergency vehicle a clear path to travel.

questions.question: When turning, you must ____ your speed.
questions.explanation: Slow down before turning so you can control your vehicle, stay in your lane, and handle surprises.

questions.question: At an uncontrolled intersection, you should:

options.text: Keep going at the same speed.
Stop, look both ways, then go.
Let all other drivers go first.
Be ready to yield if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to yield if needed.
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no stop sign or traffic light, yield to a vehicle coming from the right. Always be ready to yield to avoid a crash. Ease off the gas, cover the brake, and look left, right, and left again.

questions.question: What does a single dashed yellow line mean?

options.text: You may pass if it is safe.
Both lanes go in the same direction.
You may pass, even if it is dangerous.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: A single dashed yellow line means you can pass other cars. You may only pass if it is safe and you will not hit oncoming traffic.

questions.question: When a traffic light turns green, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up as fast as you can.
Wait for another driver to wave you on.

questions.explanation: A green light means you can go. But first, let any pedestrians or other traffic clear the intersection.

questions.question: You turn onto a two-lane road with a broken yellow line. What does this tell you?

options.text: You must stay to the left of the line.

questions.explanation: A yellow centerline means traffic moves in opposite directions. A broken line can be crossed when it is safe to pass slower traffic.

questions.question: Signs that warn about dangerous conditions are called:
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to potential hazards. Follow warning signs to stay safe. Ignoring them can cause accidents.

questions.question: You are driving slowly and cars are backing up behind you. What should you do?

options.text: Pull to the right side and let traffic pass.
Do not let other cars pass you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right side and let traffic pass.
questions.explanation: Driving much slower than other traffic is unsafe. If you are on a two-lane road and cars are backed up behind you, pull to the right and let them pass.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road here. Slow down, watch carefully, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: You must stop at an intersection when you see:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same thing as a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, check both ways, and go only when it is safe.

questions.question: Orange signs are:
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of work zones. They are usually diamond-shaped with black text and warn that workers are on or near the road.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing with more than one track, you should:

options.text: Wait until you can see all tracks clearly before going.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
Go as soon as the train passes.
Go when one track is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see all tracks clearly before going.
questions.explanation: At a crossing with multiple tracks, do not move until you can see all tracks and are sure no other trains are coming. Always check before crossing.

questions.question: When may you cross solid yellow lines?

options.text: To pass traffic going the same direction.

questions.explanation: Broken yellow lines can be crossed, but solid yellow lines cannot. You may cross a solid yellow line only when turning.

questions.question: Distracted driving is:

options.text: Just as safe as normal driving.

questions.explanation: Distracted driving is extremely dangerous. It puts you, your passengers, pedestrians, cyclists, and other drivers at risk. Paying full attention to the road helps prevent crashes.

questions.question: Bicyclists:

options.text: Can ride side-by-side on the road.
Can ride two across on bike paths, unless a sign says otherwise.
Can hold onto a moving vehicle while riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can ride two across on bike paths, unless a sign says otherwise.
questions.explanation: On the road, bicyclists must ride single file. On a bike path or lane that is wide enough, they can ride two across if it does not block traffic.

questions.question: To check your blind spots before changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Turn your head and look over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Turn your head to check your blind spots before every lane change.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: When dealing with pedestrians, a driver must:

options.text: Make sure the pedestrian sees your vehicle.
Always give pedestrians the right-of-way, even if they are wrong.
Only give the right-of-way when the pedestrian is legally entitled to it.
Slow down and honk near a crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always give pedestrians the right-of-way, even if they are wrong.
questions.explanation: You must do everything possible to avoid hitting a pedestrian or another vehicle. It is your job as a driver to watch for pedestrians and let them cross safely, even if they are crossing where they should not.

questions.question: You should increase your following distance when:

options.text: Driving behind a large vehicle that blocks your view.

questions.explanation: Increase your following distance when behind a large vehicle blocking your view, in bad weather or heavy traffic, when leaving a highway, when behind a motorcycle or bicycle, and when another vehicle is tailgating you.

questions.question: To avoid hitting vehicles in your blind spots, you should:

options.text: Turn your head quickly to check your blind spot before changing lanes.
Adjust your rearview mirrors every few minutes.
Honk your horn right before turning or changing lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head quickly to check your blind spot before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Before turning or changing lanes, turn your head and look over your shoulder in the direction you are moving to check your blind spot. Do not rely on mirrors alone.

questions.question: What is a "No zone?"

options.text: An area where passing is not allowed
The blind spot area around a large vehicle
An area for motor vehicles only

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot area around a large vehicle
questions.explanation: "No zones" are the large blind spots around trucks and big vehicles. Avoid staying in these spots.

questions.question: Drowsy drivers:

options.text: Should drink strong black coffee to stay awake.
Can drive so badly they look drunk.
Can stay alert by opening a window and turning up the radio.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can drive so badly they look drunk.
questions.explanation: Drowsy drivers can drive so poorly that they appear drunk. Opening a window, turning on the radio, or drinking coffee is not enough to help a drowsy driver stay alert to dangers on the road.

questions.question: You can pass another vehicle if the line between your lane and the lane you want to enter is a ____ line.
questions.explanation: White lines divide lanes going the same direction. You can cross a broken white line to pass if the lane ahead is clear.
